about_the_game: Embark on an adventure with Kam and Simon who were mysteriously summoned to the mystical land of SclObonia. Throughout their journey, the two cousins must unravel secrets long forgotten, battle against savage monstrosities, and stand against the fathomless legions of the Unshook if they’re to ever find a way back home.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo @ 2.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9.0c compatible GPU with at least 512 MB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Any modern PC capable of running basic 2D games should suffice

short_description: Join Kam and Simon on their journey as they trek through the world of SclObonia, based on SclObo's "Tales of SclObonia" light novels.
